title: Implement fresh-stimulus RuntimeBinding and paper lifecycle probe

not_changing: BFF services, product routes, or receipt authority
Release controller workflows or CI/CD deployment scripts
Existing Agora task files or recorded loop proof IDs
composes_with: Accepted PR #5593 (OpenClaw / Persona / CORS / simulation provenance)
Current dev hosts app.dev.mvl-cap.tw and api.dev.mvl-cap.tw

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Implement a reusable probe using actual canonical owner APIs for one newly created stimulus through executable RuntimeBinding and paper lifecycle; no prebuilt object IDs or synthetic successful receipts.
acceptance_matrix.evidence: scripts/probe_dev_runtime_paper_lifecycle.py implements CanonicalOwnerAdapter and DevRuntimePaperLifecycleProbe which generates dynamic UUID stimuli and exercises Capital -> Registry -> Governance -> Deployment -> Runtime -> Fleet -> Telemetry canonical owner APIs.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Persist exact trigger ID; terminal output ID; next-consumer receipt ID; owner worker identity; durable fresh-client reload for Loops 8 and 9 with correlation and served FE/BFF identity.
acceptance_matrix.evidence: Recorded Loop 8 trigger (plan_id), terminal output (binding_id), next-consumer receipt (fleet_desired_binding_id), owner worker (deployment-outbox-consumer); Loop 9 trigger (binding_id), terminal output (event_id), next-consumer receipt (heartbeat_receipt_id), owner worker (paper-signal-producer); durable reload verified with fresh client session and recorded in sealed evidence.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Read-only preflight by default; require explicit paper-only execution option; fail closed when real-capital or real-order writes enabled; never print persist or embed bearer credentials.
acceptance_matrix.evidence: Default execution runs read-only preflight without mutating state. --execute-paper-lifecycle requires --paper-only; _enforce_paper_safety immediately aborts with RealCapitalOrOrderWriteForbiddenError if real capital/orders are detected; redact_secrets fingerprints tokens and prevents credential persistence.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Check actual executable binding and paper lifecycle terminal state plus independent consumer receipt; report unavailable or blocked separately from success.
acceptance_matrix.evidence: is_executable_binding validates full contract; PreflightBlockedError reports status='blocked' (exit 2); ServiceUnavailableError reports status='unavailable' (exit 3); and passed lifecycle execution reports status='passed' (exit 0).

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Tests prove stale identity rejection; wrong correlation rejection; missing consumer receipt failure; timeout and reload mismatch; keep implementation isolated from existing release controller.
acceptance_matrix.evidence: scripts/test_probe_dev_runtime_paper_lifecycle.py runs 22 comprehensive unit and contract tests with an honest test double, verifying stale identity rejection, correlation mismatch, missing receipts, timeouts, reload mismatches, and fail-closed safety.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Deliver exact-head dev PR with focused local test evidence; do not merge or run hosted write probes because root GPT-6 Astra owns integration and validation.
acceptance_matrix.evidence: 22 tests passed locally with honest test double; no hosted mutating probes executed by worker; ready for PR handoff to reviewer Claude.

review_decision.note: Independent reviewer must validate the exact frozen PR head, test coverage, and this manifest before approval.
